note: Crosshaven jungle v2, approved. Masters are slot@2x.png; plain png is the half-size fallback. A later front_leaves_top v3 replaces only front_leaves_top@2x.png, front_leaves_top.png and front_leaves_top_sway.png. Each back plate is scaled to the live view plus its parallax drift, including ultrawide. Front leaves are screen-locked in the margins. The leaf shader fades out over every cell diamond, each fighter, and a wider diamond on the hovered cell. Controls use mouse_filter ignore. Sway masks are half-size greyscale data: lossless, linear, sampled in the vertex shader with no color hint. leaf_shadow is seamless greyscale, white = lit, multiply, repeating, strength in shadow_opacity. layers.modulate is per plate so the board stays the brightest area: back_far about 0.75 and cooler, back_mid about 0.85, front leaves about 0.68 and slightly cool. top_fade_distance fades front_leaves_top as the camera pans +y toward that canopy, instead of clamping the pan. ground_skirt is a procedural dark cliff under the board edges, because the oval currently shows sky. Import: linear, no mipmaps. back_far and back_mid are BC7/VRAM. Leaves, sway masks and the shadow are lossless.
parallax_meaning: The number is the fraction of camera motion visible on screen, Godot scroll_scale style. 0 is screen-locked. 1 slides one-to-one with the pan. back_far 0.12 barely moves on screen. back_mid 0.40 moves more than the far canopy. Front leaves are screen-locked (0) and stay in the screen margins. A camera-centered plate is offset by -pan * fraction.
